news-gebe-okulu.title: Preparing for Birth and Parenthood at Güven Pregnancy School
paragraphs: At Güven Healthcare Group, we held Güven Pregnancy School on October 23 at Güven Çayyolu, bringing expectant mothers together with accurate information and expert support throughout the journey from pregnancy to the postpartum period. The program addressed the physical, psychological and social changes of pregnancy, birth and the postpartum period, and shared comprehensive information to help expectant mothers prepare for this process with awareness and confidence.

Throughout the day, sessions led by healthcare professionals from various specialties covered many topics, including pregnancy follow-up, birth preparation, nutrition during pregnancy, anesthesia in childbirth, the postpartum period, postpartum psychological changes, breastfeeding and newborn care. The program, ranging from prenatal yoga to postpartum exercises, concluded with a Q&A session where participants found answers to their questions. We thank all the expectant mothers who attended Güven Pregnancy School, which supports them in preparing confidently for their pregnancy and parenting journey, and our experts who shared their knowledge and experience.

news-peryon-longevity.title: We Heard About Longevity from Prof. Dr. Pelin Arıbal Ayral at the PERYÖN Networking Meeting
paragraphs: Güven Healthcare Group hosted the first networking meeting of the PERYÖN Central Anatolia Branch. At the event, which brought together business professionals, the topic “Longevity in Corporate Life” was discussed with the participation of Prof. Dr. Pelin Arıbal Ayral.

The meeting, which assessed the importance of employee health, well-being and sustainable performance for organizations, provided a productive environment for sharing knowledge and experience among participants. We thank all the professionals who attended this meaningful gathering, where new connections were made and different perspectives were shared, and the PERYÖN Central Anatolia Branch for its contributions.

news-peryon-davet.title: PERYÖN’s First Networking Meeting at Güven
paragraphs: We are delighted to host the first networking meeting of the PERYÖN Central Anatolia Branch as Güven Healthcare Group. At this special meeting bringing together business professionals, we will discuss Longevity in Corporate Life with Prof. Dr. Pelin Arıbal Ayral and talk about the importance of employee health, well-being and sustainable performance for organizations.

We look forward to welcoming all participants to the Güven Çayyolu Healthy Living Campus to make new connections, exchange ideas and enjoy inspiring conversations. Date: Thursday, October 22, 2026, 6:00 PM–8:30 PM. Venue: Güven Çayyolu Healthy Living Campus – Rejuvenation Clinic.

news-gebe-okulu-davet.title: Birth and Parenthood Preparation Day at Güven Pregnancy School
paragraphs: Pregnancy, birth and the postpartum period are a special time in which expectant mothers experience many physical, psychological and social changes. During this period, it is very important to access accurate information, prepare for birth and build an informed roadmap for the time after the baby arrives. Güven Pregnancy School brings expectant mothers together with experts on this journey from pregnancy to the postpartum period.

The program will take place on Friday, October 23, from 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM at Güven Çayyolu. Sessions ranging from prenatal yoga to pregnancy check-ups, from birth to the postpartum period, and from breastfeeding to the baby’s first examination will run throughout the day and conclude with a Q&A section. You are invited to approach your pregnancy with accurate information and expert support, and to prepare together for birth and the new chapter with your baby.
